ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious MSDT Parent Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects msdt.exe executed by a suspicious parent as seen in CVE-2022-30190 / Follina exploitation

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wsl\\\.exe$")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\msdt\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "msdt\.exe"))
